notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to The Jolly Balloon Man.
description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
